notes: «وقال عمر بن يزيد: قلت لأبي عبد الله» — the asker is a link, the Imam named in the words is the last link (rule 5, owner ruling 2)
the second question («فأشرك بين رجلين») and the Imam's continuing words are the same asker and Imam: one route
the closing «ويجوز أن يجعل ...» is the continuation of the Imam's words, with no new transmitter
